player_0.content: New plan: I failed because my clue "I identify the problem, then I fix it" directly used the related word "fix," which is explicitly forbidden by rule (b) and leads to an immediate loss under rule (i). Next time, I will avoid naming any related words (fix, debug, diagnose) entirely.
